sloka: पुरा कृतयुगे राजन्ब्राह्मणा वै तपस्विनः ।अब्राह्मणस्तदा राजन्न तपस्वी कथञ्चन ।। ७.७४.९ ॥
transliteration: purā kṛtayuge rājanbrāhmaṇā vai tapasvinaḥ ।abrāhmaṇastadā rājanna tapasvī kathañcana ।। 7.74.9 ॥

translations.english: O King, in the ancient Krita Yuga, only brahmins were ascetics, and no non-brahmin was an ascetic by any means.
